# NexRNN Technologies

> Digital marketing agency and technology solutions company based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Also provides practical, career-focused courses in Digital Marketing, Artificial Intelligence, and Website Development.

NexRNN Technologies helps businesses build, market, and grow their digital presence through Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, website development, branding, and related technology services. Separately, it runs skill-focused training courses for students and professionals.

## Services

- Google Ads / PPC management
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) management
- Social Media Marketing and Management
- Google Business Profile (GMB) optimization and local SEO
- Website Development (business sites, landing pages, e-commerce, React, WordPress)
- Website Design (UI/UX)
- SEO (technical, on-page, local)
- Graphic Design and Branding
- Video Editing and AI Video Creation
- Brand Promotion and Digital Marketing Strategy

Full list with details: https://nexrnntechnology.in/services

## Courses

- Digital Marketing — SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, analytics, lead generation
- Artificial Intelligence — AI fundamentals, generative AI, prompt engineering, practical AI tools
- Website Development — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Git, deployment

Full list with details: https://nexrnntechnology.in/course
